cocktails.name: Boulevardier
cocktails.notes: Equal parts is the original; the extra whiskey keeps it from getting syrupy.

cocktails.name: Brandy Crusta
cocktails.garnish: sugar rim and long lemon peel

cocktails.name: Canchanchara
cocktails.notes: Dissolve the honey in the water and lime juice before adding ice and aguardiente.

cocktails.name: Champagne Cocktail
cocktails.notes: IBA allows a few drops of Grand Marnier as an optional addition.

cocktails.name: El Presidente
cocktails.notes: Use a blanc (bianco) vermouth, not a French dry.

cocktails.name: French 75
cocktails.notes: Cognac instead of gin is the other classic.

cocktails.name: Gimlet
cocktails.notes: Fresh-lime version. For the original, use 22.5 ml lime cordial and stir.

cocktails.name: Gin Fizz
cocktails.notes: Serve without ice; add just a splash of soda.

cocktails.name: Hemingway Daiquiri
cocktails.notes: No added sugar; it should be tart.

cocktails.name: IBA Tiki
cocktails.notes: Muddle a thin slice of ginger before shaking.

cocktails.name: Illegal
cocktails.notes: IBA allows a few drops of egg white as an optional addition.

cocktails.name: Irish Coffee
cocktails.notes: Warm the glass first. Cream poured over a spoon, not stirred in.

cocktails.name: Jack Rose
cocktails.notes: Use a real pomegranate grenadine; it carries the drink.

cocktails.name: John Collins
cocktails.notes: Old Tom gin makes the Tom Collins variant.

cocktails.name: Mai Tai
cocktails.garnish: mint sprig and spent lime shell

cocktails.name: Missionary's Downfall
cocktails.notes: Blend with half a cup of crushed ice.

cocktails.name: New York Sour
cocktails.notes: Float the red wine; rye or bourbon may be used.

cocktails.name: Old Cuban
cocktails.notes: Add the Champagne after straining.

cocktails.name: Old Fashioned
cocktails.notes: Rye works just as well; a sugar cube muddled with the bitters is the older form.

cocktails.name: Pisco Punch
cocktails.notes: Muddle the cloves in the syrup; add the wine after double-straining.

cocktails.name: Planter's Punch
cocktails.notes: IBA leaves dilution to taste; this version uses ice.

cocktails.name: Porn Star Martini
cocktails.notes: Serve the Champagne separately alongside the cocktail.

cocktails.name: Remember the Maine
cocktails.notes: Use the absinthe to rinse the glass, then discard. Cherry Heering replaces the IBA-specified Luxardo cherry brandy.

cocktails.name: Sazerac
cocktails.notes: Served neat in a chilled glass. Half rye, half cognac is a good variation.

cocktails.name: Sherry Cobbler
cocktails.garnish: berries, orange and lemon quarter wheels
cocktails.notes: Use half a wheel each of orange and lemon, cut into quarters.

cocktails.name: Singapore Sling
cocktails.notes: Cherry Heering replaces the IBA-specified Sangue Morlacco cherry liqueur.

cocktails.name: Southside
cocktails.notes: Lemon is also traditional; top with soda in a highball for a Southside Fizz.

cocktails.name: Spicy Fifty
cocktails.notes: Use thin chili slices; double-strain.

cocktails.name: Suffering Bastard
cocktails.notes: Pour unstrained and finish with ginger beer.

cocktails.name: Three Dots and a Dash
cocktails.garnish: three cherries and a rectangular pineapple chunk

cocktails.name: Tom Collins
cocktails.notes: London dry makes a drier drink.

cocktails.name: Ve.N.To
cocktails.notes: The honey mix may use chamomile infusion in place of water; egg white is optional.

cocktails.name: Vesper
cocktails.notes: IBA spec. Fleming's original is 90 ml gin, 30 ml vodka and 15 ml Kina Lillet.

cocktails.name: Zombie
cocktails.notes: Flash blend for about five seconds with 180 ml crushed ice. Limit two per guest.
